summary:
Comprehensive plan for platform-scoped bout assignments and side-scorer score consensus isolation:
- Admin bulk & individual bout-to-platform assignment in Bracket Viewer & Admin Panel
- Strict platform filtering for Mat Officials in LiveScoringArena (only assigned platform bouts visible)
- Strict platform filtering for Side Scorers in SidelineJudgeScoringPanel
- Live submitted judges scorecards comparison panel embedded directly on the platform Mat Official console
- Strict role and platform isolation ensuring only the platform's Mat Official and Admins can view submitted scores
